knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An extension tool from a stable floor position avoids the fall risk of standing on furniture.
A dust mask is added where dust is heavy. It is not needed for every dusting task.
Loose items are reported to the site contact and not moved by the worker.

practicalCriteria: Puts on eye protection before dusting, and adds a fitted dust mask where dust is heavy.
Reaches all high points with an extension tool from a stable floor position, with no standing on furniture.
Identifies a loose item on a shelf, leaves it in place, and reports it with its location.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of a dusting task with shelves
Near miss or unstable item report, where applicable
stopWorkCriteria: Worker stands on a chair, desk or drawer to reach a shelf
Loose item moved by the worker without a report
